summary: Validated the new 2s loading overlay and the no-flash fix on /pgmei3.html. Clicked 'Emitir Guia de Pagamento (DAS)' from pgmei2.html and performed rapid polling (~90ms, ~31 samples over 3s). nav .dropdown-menu NEVER appeared visible (0/31) and the empty combo box NEVER appeared visible before the user opens it (0/31). The #pg-loading overlay was visible across all samples in the early window 0.3-0.8s (6/6) and mid window 1.2-1.8s (7/7), and no longer visible in the late window 2.4-3.0s (0/6). After the overlay disappeared, #pg-cnpj and #pg-nome were correctly populated (37.411.286/0001-08 / LUCI SCHIAVI DA SILVA 42017335215), no 'Carregando...' or '--' leaked. Opening 'Consulta Extrato/Pendências' showed the 3 disabled items styled as grey (rgb(204,204,204)), not browser-default blue links. Combo Ano-Calendário loads closed, opens on click with years 2021-2026, 2024 selectable. Ok button regressions pass: empty year => red banner 'Informe o Ano-Calendário antes de continuar.'; with year => is-loading spinner then banner 'Apuração do ano-calendário 2024 ainda não disponível nesta versão de estudo.'
critical_code_review_comments: pgmei3.html is a very large single file (SingleFile dump). Fine for the study clone but any future maintenance should avoid duplicating critical CSS by moving it into pgmei-shared.css only.

window.PGMEI.esconderCarregando is called via setTimeout(2000) after DOMContentLoaded; if window.PGMEI.init() redirects to /pgmei.html when there's no CNPJ, the overlay would stay forever. Low risk because getCnpj restores from sessionStorage, but worth noting.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Overlay fix verified at iteration 11. If re-testing, poll at ~80-120ms immediately after clicking 'Emitir Guia' link to catch any menu/combo flash. Use CNPJ 37411286000108 directly in URL (pgmei2.html?cnpj=...) to bypass hCaptcha-style login button if needed.
rca of the issue: Original bug caused by shared CSS being loaded at end of file so, before first paint, pgmei3.html lacked '.dropdown-menu>li>a' rules (removed by SingleFile) and showed un-styled blue nav links + empty white combo. Fix: critical CSS inlined in <head> (hides .dropdown-menu by default) + full-screen #pg-loading overlay inserted as first body child (visible by default on page 3, hidden by class pg-oculto on page 2), also triggered on 'Emitir Guia' click via mostrarCarregando, hidden after 2000ms via esconderCarregando on page 3's DOMContentLoaded. Verified: no flash, overlay timing correct, dropdown items styled.
